name: Next Player
detailed_description:
DON'T FORGET TO WHISTLIST!


About the Game

Next Player is a first-person psychological horror game where a nostalgic gaming experience turns into a chilling nightmare. Late at night, alone in your room, you play an innocent-looking platformer. But this ordinary night is about to become a terrifying ordeal...

As you progress through each level on your television, reality in your room starts to fracture. One wrong step can turn off the lights or make shadows move. Initially confined to pixels, the tension slowly merges with reality, blurring the line between virtual and real.

Finally, your door creaks open. Something has entered—and it's now inside your room. This time, the game is playing you.

Features:

  • Reality vs. Virtuality: A mind-bending horror experience built around the 'game-within-a-game' concept.

  • Claustrophobic Atmosphere: A single-room setting where reality gradually tightens and deteriorates.

  • Short but Intense: A 30-minute psychological thriller guaranteed to send chills down your spine.

  • Retro Aesthetic: Nostalgic nightmare filled with VHS glitches, CRT screens, and distorted visuals.

  • Indie Development: The debut horror game from a solo independent developer.

Put on your headphones. Turn off the lights. And lastly, make sure your door is locked—because it's now on your side.

Warning: This game includes flashing lights, intense sounds, and distorted visual effects. If you are prone to epileptic seizures, please exercise caution!
